title: FAST 五百公尺口徑球面電波望遠鏡
subcategoryTitle: 大型望遠鏡與重力波觀測站
summary: 從半徑 300 m 球面的球差出發，理解 FAST 如何以約 2225 台促動器把 300 m 照明區即時拉成拋物面、用六索饋源艙追焦，再把天頂角極限、索網疲勞、面形量測、指向模型、19 波束接收機與電波寧靜區整合成可驗收的單口徑電波望遠鏡工程紀錄。
summaryEn: Starting from the spherical aberration of a 300 m-radius sphere, see how FAST pulls a 300 m illuminated patch into a paraboloid with about 2225 actuators and follows the focus with a six-cable feed cabin, then integrate the zenith-angle limit, cable-net fatigue, surface metrology, pointing model, 19-beam receiver and radio quiet zone into an acceptable single-dish engineering record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「球面球差與主動拋物面成形」與「天頂角極限與有效接收面積」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Spherical aberration and active paraboloid forming" and "Zenith-angle limit and effective collecting area": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 球面球差與主動拋物面成形：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Spherical aberration and active paraboloid forming: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「500 m 球面與 300 m 照明口徑」如何決定FAST 五百公尺口徑球面電波望遠鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “500 m sphere and 300 m illuminated aperture” determines the key performance of “FAST Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: FAST 的反射面是半徑 R = 300 m、口徑 500 m 的球冠，安置在貴州平塘大窩凼的喀斯特窪地中。球面沒有特定光軸，只要移動饋源就能指向不同方向，但球面有球差：不同高度入射的平行光在軸上交於不同位置，單點饋源無法同相收集。Arecibo 用線饋源與格里高利副鏡修正；FAST 則用索網節點下方的促動器，把以源方向為軸、直徑 300 m 的一塊球面即時拉成 f/D = 0.4665 的拋物面，追蹤時讓這塊拋物面在球面上「移動」，饋源艙則沿焦面跟隨，其餘部分保持球面。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「500 m 球面與 300 m 照明口徑」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: FAST's reflector is a spherical cap of radius R = 300 m and aperture 500 m set into the Dawodang karst depression in Pingtang, Guizhou. A sphere has no preferred axis, so pointing only requires moving the feed, but it suffers spherical aberration: parallel rays at different heights cross the axis at different points and a point feed cannot collect them in phase. Arecibo corrected this with line feeds and a Gregorian subreflector; FAST instead uses actuators under the cable-net nodes to pull a 300 m-diameter patch, centred on the source direction, into a paraboloid with f/D = 0.4665, and tracks by moving that paraboloid across the sphere while the feed cabin follows along the focal surface and the rest of the dish stays spherical. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “500 m sphere and 300 m illuminated aperture”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：球差估算：近軸焦點在頂點上方 R/2 = 150 m；r = 150 m 的邊緣光（入射角 θ = 30°）交軸於距球心 R/(2cosθ) = 173.2 m，即頂點上方 126.8 m，縱向球差 23.2 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Aberration estimate: the paraxial focus is R/2 = 150 m above the vertex; the marginal ray at r = 150 m (incidence θ = 30°) crosses the axis R/(2cosθ) = 173.2 m from the centre, 126.8 m above the vertex, a longitudinal spherical aberration of 23.2 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「FAST 觀測時會把整個 500 m 反射面變成一個拋物面。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "FAST deforms its whole 500 m dish into a single paraboloid when observing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「500 m 球面與 300 m 照明口徑」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “500 m sphere and 300 m illuminated aperture”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Spherical aberration and active paraboloid forming

A sphere has no preferred axis, so pointing only requires moving the feed, but it suffers spherical aberration: parallel rays at different heights cross the axis at different points and a point feed cannot collect them in phase.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：FAST 觀測時會把整個 500 m 反射面變成一個拋物面。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「FAST 五百公尺口徑球面電波望遠鏡」的「球面球差與主動拋物面成形：原理與系統邊界」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出試件、激發、光路或訊號路徑與讀出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「觀測站：找回微弱訊號」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與校正件識別、暗場或零點、原始訊號與取樣設定的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Spherical aberration and active paraboloid forming: mechanism and system boundary” in “FAST Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical Telescope”. Draw the specimen, excitation, optical/signal path and readout boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Observatory: Recover a Faint Signal” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for reference-artifact identity, dark/zero records, raw signals and sampling settings, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「球面球差與主動拋物面成形」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Spherical aberration and active paraboloid forming" is correct?
options: FAST 觀測時會把整個 500 m 反射面變成一個拋物面。
FAST 的反射面是半徑 R = 300 m、口徑 500 m 的球冠，安置在貴州平塘大窩凼的喀斯特窪地中。
FAST 反射面固定不動，所以增益與天頂角無關。
optionsEn: FAST deforms its whole 500 m dish into a single paraboloid when observing.
FAST's reflector is a spherical cap of radius R = 300 m and aperture 500 m set into the Dawodang karst depression in Pingtang, Guizhou.
Because FAST's dish never moves, its gain does not depend on zenith angle.
quiz.explanation: FAST 的反射面是半徑 R = 300 m、口徑 500 m 的球冠，安置在貴州平塘大窩凼的喀斯特窪地中。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: FAST's reflector is a spherical cap of radius R = 300 m and aperture 500 m set into the Dawodang karst depression in Pingtang, Guizhou. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 球面球差與主動拋物面成形：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Spherical aberration and active paraboloid forming: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「500 m 球面與 300 m 照明口徑」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “500 m sphere and 300 m illuminated aperture” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：球差估算：近軸焦點在頂點上方 R/2 = 150 m；r = 150 m 的邊緣光（入射角 θ = 30°）交軸於距球心 R/(2cosθ) = 173.2 m，即頂點上方 126.8 m，縱向球差 23.2 m。拋物面焦距 F = 0.4665 × 300 = 139.95 m；若令拋物面在 r = 150 m 處與球面重合（兩者矢高都是 40.19 m），最大軸向偏離 0.72 m 出現在 r ≈ 106 m，換成法向約 0.72 × cos20.7° ≈ 0.67 m，促動器行程必須涵蓋此值再加裕度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Aberration estimate: the paraxial focus is R/2 = 150 m above the vertex; the marginal ray at r = 150 m (incidence θ = 30°) crosses the axis R/(2cosθ) = 173.2 m from the centre, 126.8 m above the vertex, a longitudinal spherical aberration of 23.2 m. The paraboloid focal length is F = 0.4665 × 300 = 139.95 m; if it meets the sphere at r = 150 m (both sags 40.19 m), the largest axial departure is 0.72 m at r ≈ 106 m, about 0.72 × cos20.7° ≈ 0.67 m along the normal, which the actuator stroke must cover with margin. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以球心座標系計算目標拋物面對球面的偏離圖，核對下達給各節點的位移指令峰值約 0.67 m 且不超過促動器行程；成形後用全站儀量所有節點，對殘差擬合拋物面的頂點、焦點與軸向，確認擬合焦距接近 139.95 m、焦點與饋源艙位置一致；最後對強校準源做饋源軸向掃焦，增益最大值應落在幾何焦點附近。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute the departure map of the target paraboloid from the sphere in sphere-centred coordinates and check that the commanded node displacements peak near 0.67 m within actuator stroke; after forming, survey every node with total stations and fit vertex, focus and axis to the residuals, confirming a fitted focal length near 139.95 m and a focus coincident with the feed cabin; finally run an axial focus scan of the feed on a strong calibrator, whose gain maximum should fall near the geometric focus.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Aberration estimate: the paraxial focus is R/2 = 150 m above the vertex; the marginal ray at r = 150 m (incidence θ = 30°) crosses the axis R/(2cosθ) = 173.2 m from the centre, 126.8 m above the vertex, a longitudinal spherical aberration of 23.2 m. The paraboloid focal length is F = 0.4665 × 300 = 139.95 m; if it meets the sphere at r = 150 m (both sags 40.19 m), the largest axial departure is 0.72 m at r ≈ 106 m, about 0.72 × cos20.7° ≈ 0.67 m along the normal, which the actuator stroke must cover with margin.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「球面球差與主動拋物面成形」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Spherical aberration and active paraboloid forming", which statement holds?
options: 只要控制六根鋼索長度，饋源艙就能直接達到毫米級定位。
相對 140 m 焦距，10 mm 的饋源誤差可以忽略。
球差估算：近軸焦點在頂點上方 R/2 = 150 m。
optionsEn: Controlling the six cable lengths alone puts the feed cabin to millimetre accuracy.
A 10 mm feed error is negligible against a 140 m focal length.
Aberration estimate: the paraxial focus is R/2 = 150 m above the vertex.
quiz.explanation: 球差估算：近軸焦點在頂點上方 R/2 = 150 m；r = 150 m 的邊緣光（入射角 θ = 30°）交軸於距球心 R/(2cosθ) = 173.2 m，即頂點上方 126.8 m，縱向球差 23.2 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Aberration estimate: the paraxial focus is R/2 = 150 m above the vertex; the marginal ray at r = 150 m (incidence θ = 30°) crosses the axis R/(2cosθ) = 173.2 m from the centre, 126.8 m above the vertex, a longitudinal spherical aberration of 23.2 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 球面球差與主動拋物面成形：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Spherical aberration and active paraboloid forming: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「500 m 球面與 300 m 照明口徑」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “500 m sphere and 300 m illuminated aperture” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以球心座標系計算目標拋物面對球面的偏離圖，核對下達給各節點的位移指令峰值約 0.67 m 且不超過促動器行程；成形後用全站儀量所有節點，對殘差擬合拋物面的頂點、焦點與軸向，確認擬合焦距接近 139.95 m、焦點與饋源艙位置一致；最後對強校準源做饋源軸向掃焦，增益最大值應落在幾何焦點附近。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute the departure map of the target paraboloid from the sphere in sphere-centred coordinates and check that the commanded node displacements peak near 0.67 m within actuator stroke; after forming, survey every node with total stations and fit vertex, focus and axis to the residuals, confirming a fitted focal length near 139.95 m and a focus coincident with the feed cabin; finally run an axial focus scan of the feed on a strong calibrator, whose gain maximum should fall near the geometric focus. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若焦距參數或拋物面軸向與源方向不同步，饋源不在真正焦點，主波束變寬、旁瓣升高、增益下降；若某區促動器在 0.67 m 峰值處飽和，會留下一圈仍是球面的環帶，形成環狀相位誤差，波束圖出現不對稱的彗形旁瓣。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the focal-length parameter or paraboloid axis falls out of step with the source direction, the feed is not at the true focus, so the main beam broadens, sidelobes rise and gain drops; if actuators saturate near the 0.67 m peak zone, a ring of residual sphere remains, producing an annular phase error and asymmetric coma-like sidelobes in the beam map.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.text: 以球心座標系計算目標拋物面對球面的偏離圖，核對下達給各節點的位移指令峰值約 0.67 m 且不超過促動器行程；成形後用全站儀量所有節點，對殘差擬合拋物面的頂點、焦點與軸向，確認擬合焦距接近 139.95 m、焦點與饋源艙位置一致；最後對強校準源做饋源軸向掃焦，增益最大值應落在幾何焦點附近。
knowledge.textEn: Compute the departure map of the target paraboloid from the sphere in sphere-centred coordinates and check that the commanded node displacements peak near 0.67 m within actuator stroke; after forming, survey every node with total stations and fit vertex, focus and axis to the residuals, confirming a fitted focal length near 139.95 m and a focus coincident with the feed cabin; finally run an axial focus scan of the feed on a strong calibrator, whose gain maximum should fall near the geometric focus.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「球面球差與主動拋物面成形」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Spherical aberration and active paraboloid forming"?
options: 以球心座標系計算目標拋物面對球面的偏離圖，核對下達給各節點的位移指令峰值約 0.67 m 且不超過促動器行程。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
頻譜基線漣波只來自接收機電子，與望遠鏡幾何無關。
optionsEn: Compute the departure map of the target paraboloid from the sphere in sphere-centred coordinates and check that the commanded node displacements peak near 0.67 m within actuator stroke.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Spectral baseline ripple comes only from receiver electronics, not telescope geometry.
quiz.explanation: 以球心座標系計算目標拋物面對球面的偏離圖，核對下達給各節點的位移指令峰值約 0.67 m 且不超過促動器行程；成形後用全站儀量所有節點，對殘差擬合拋物面的頂點、焦點與軸向，確認擬合焦距接近 139.95 m、焦點與饋源艙位置一致；最後對強校準源做饋源軸向掃焦，增益最大值應落在幾何焦點附近。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compute the departure map of the target paraboloid from the sphere in sphere-centred coordinates and check that the commanded node displacements peak near 0.67 m within actuator stroke; after forming, survey every node with total stations and fit vertex, focus and axis to the residuals, confirming a fitted focal length near 139.95 m and a focus coincident with the feed cabin; finally run an axial focus scan of the feed on a strong calibrator, whose gain maximum should fall near the geometric focus. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 球面球差與主動拋物面成形：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Spherical aberration and active paraboloid forming: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「500 m 球面與 300 m 照明口徑」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “500 m sphere and 300 m illuminated aperture” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若焦距參數或拋物面軸向與源方向不同步，饋源不在真正焦點，主波束變寬、旁瓣升高、增益下降；若某區促動器在 0.67 m 峰值處飽和，會留下一圈仍是球面的環帶，形成環狀相位誤差，波束圖出現不對稱的彗形旁瓣。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the focal-length parameter or paraboloid axis falls out of step with the source direction, the feed is not at the true focus, so the main beam broadens, sidelobes rise and gain drops; if actuators saturate near the 0.67 m peak zone, a ring of residual sphere remains, producing an annular phase error and asymmetric coma-like sidelobes in the beam map. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：Arecibo 用線饋源與格里高利副鏡修正；FAST 則用索網節點下方的促動器，把以源方向為軸、直徑 300 m 的一塊球面即時拉成 f/D = 0.4665 的拋物面，追蹤時讓這塊拋物面在球面上「移動」，饋源艙則沿焦面跟隨，其餘部分保持球面。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Arecibo corrected this with line feeds and a Gregorian subreflector; FAST instead uses actuators under the cable-net nodes to pull a 300 m-diameter patch, centred on the source direction, into a paraboloid with f/D = 0.4665, and tracks by moving that paraboloid across the sphere while the feed cabin follows along the focal surface and the rest of the dish stays spherical.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「FAST 觀測時會把整個 500 m 反射面變成一個拋物面。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "FAST deforms its whole 500 m dish into a single paraboloid when observing." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若焦距參數或拋物面軸向與源方向不同步，饋源不在真正焦點，主波束變寬、旁瓣升高、增益下降；若某區促動器在 0.67 m 峰值處飽和，會留下一圈仍是球面的環帶，形成環狀相位誤差，波束圖出現不對稱的彗形旁瓣。
knowledge.textEn: If the focal-length parameter or paraboloid axis falls out of step with the source direction, the feed is not at the true focus, so the main beam broadens, sidelobes rise and gain drops; if actuators saturate near the 0.67 m peak zone, a ring of residual sphere remains, producing an annular phase error and asymmetric coma-like sidelobes in the beam map.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「球面球差與主動拋物面成形」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Spherical aberration and active paraboloid forming" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
若焦距參數或拋物面軸向與源方向不同步，饋源不在真正焦點，主波束變寬、旁瓣升高、增益下降。
FAST 反射面固定不動，所以增益與天頂角無關。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
If the focal-length parameter or paraboloid axis falls out of step with the source direction, the feed is not at the true focus, so the main beam broadens, sidelobes rise and gain drops.
Because FAST's dish never moves, its gain does not depend on zenith angle.
quiz.explanation: 若焦距參數或拋物面軸向與源方向不同步，饋源不在真正焦點，主波束變寬、旁瓣升高、增益下降；若某區促動器在 0.67 m 峰值處飽和，會留下一圈仍是球面的環帶，形成環狀相位誤差，波束圖出現不對稱的彗形旁瓣。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the focal-length parameter or paraboloid axis falls out of step with the source direction, the feed is not at the true focus, so the main beam broadens, sidelobes rise and gain drops; if actuators saturate near the 0.67 m peak zone, a ring of residual sphere remains, producing an annular phase error and asymmetric coma-like sidelobes in the beam map. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 天頂角極限與有效接收面積：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Zenith-angle limit and effective collecting area: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「天頂角與照明區位置」如何決定FAST 五百公尺口徑球面電波望遠鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Zenith angle and illuminated patch” determines the key performance of “FAST Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 從球心看，300 m 照明口徑對應距波束軸 30° 以內的球冠，而 500 m 邊緣位於距鉛垂 56.4° 處（張角 112.9°）。源在天上移動時，照明區在球面上遊走；只要天頂角 ζ ≤ 56.4° − 30° = 26.4°，整個 300 m 口徑都留在反射面上。超過此角度，部分照明口徑落到邊緣之外，饋源開始看見地面，有效面積下降、溢出雜訊使系統溫度上升。設計上限 ζ = 40°，配合約 25.6°N 的緯度，可觀測赤緯約 −14° 到 +66°。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「天頂角與照明區位置」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Seen from the sphere centre, the 300 m illuminated aperture is the cap within 30° of the beam axis, while the 500 m rim lies 56.4° from the vertical, an opening angle of 112.9°. As a source moves the illuminated patch walks across the sphere, and as long as the zenith angle ζ ≤ 56.4° − 30° = 26.4° the full 300 m aperture stays on the reflector. Beyond that part of the illuminated aperture falls off the rim, the feed begins to see the ground, effective area drops and spillover noise raises the system temperature. The design limit is ζ = 40°, which at about 25.6°N latitude gives declinations from about −14° to +66°. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Zenith angle and illuminated patch”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For ζ ≤ 26.4°, A_e = η·π(150 m)² = 0.63 × 70 686 = 44 532 m², gain G = A_e/(2k) ≈ 16.1 K/Jy and SEFD = T_sys/G = 24/16.1 ≈ 1.49 Jy.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「FAST 反射面固定不動，所以增益與天頂角無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Because FAST's dish never moves, its gain does not depend on zenith angle." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「天頂角與照明區位置」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Zenith angle and illuminated patch”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 天頂角極限與有效接收面積

knowledge.textEn: Seen from the sphere centre, the 300 m illuminated aperture is the cap within 30° of the beam axis, while the 500 m rim lies 56.4° from the vertical, an opening angle of 112.9°. As a source moves the illuminated patch walks across the sphere, and as long as the zenith angle ζ ≤ 56.4° − 30° = 26.4° the full 300 m aperture stays on the reflector.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：FAST 反射面固定不動，所以增益與天頂角無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Because FAST's dish never moves, its gain does not depend on zenith angle. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「天頂角極限與有效接收面積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Zenith-angle limit and effective collecting area" is correct?
options: FAST 反射面固定不動，所以增益與天頂角無關。
索網只承受靜態重量，不必考慮疲勞壽命。
從球心看，300 m 照明口徑對應距波束軸 30° 以內的球冠，而 500 m 邊緣位於距鉛垂 56.4° 處（張角 112.9°）。
optionsEn: Because FAST's dish never moves, its gain does not depend on zenith angle.
The cable net carries only static weight, so fatigue life can be ignored.
Seen from the sphere centre, the 300 m illuminated aperture is the cap within 30° of the beam axis, while the 500 m rim lies 56.4° from the vertical, an opening angle of 112.9°.
quiz.explanation: 從球心看，300 m 照明口徑對應距波束軸 30° 以內的球冠，而 500 m 邊緣位於距鉛垂 56.4° 處（張角 112.9°）。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Seen from the sphere centre, the 300 m illuminated aperture is the cap within 30° of the beam axis, while the 500 m rim lies 56.4° from the vertical, an opening angle of 112.9°. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 天頂角極限與有效接收面積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Zenith-angle limit and effective collecting area: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「天頂角與照明區位置」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Zenith angle and illuminated patch” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ζ ≤ 26.4° 時，A_e = η·π(150 m)² = 0.63 × 70 686 = 44 532 m²，增益 G = A_e/(2k) ≈ 16.1 K/Jy，SEFD = T_sys/G = 24/16.1 ≈ 1.49 Jy。幾何估算 300 m 口徑仍留在反射面上的比例：ζ = 30° 為 0.97、35° 為 0.90、40° 為 0.80（均勻照明）；若以 −10 dB 邊緣錐度加權，40° 時約 0.89。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For ζ ≤ 26.4°, A_e = η·π(150 m)² = 0.63 × 70 686 = 44 532 m², gain G = A_e/(2k) ≈ 16.1 K/Jy and SEFD = T_sys/G = 24/16.1 ≈ 1.49 Jy. A geometric estimate of the fraction of the 300 m aperture still on the dish is 0.97 at ζ = 30°, 0.90 at 35° and 0.80 at 40° for uniform illumination, or about 0.89 at 40° when weighted by a −10 dB edge taper. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立增益曲線：在多個天頂角對 3C286 等流量已知的校準源做十字掃描，取峰值天線溫度除以目錄流量得到 K/Jy，畫出對 ζ 的曲線並確認轉折出現在 26.4° 附近；同一時間用雜訊二極體量各 ζ 的 T_sys，把面積下降與溢出升溫兩個效應分開記錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build the gain curve: cross-scan a calibrator of known flux such as 3C286 at several zenith angles, divide peak antenna temperature by catalogue flux to obtain K/Jy, plot against ζ and confirm the knee near 26.4°; at the same time measure T_sys with the noise diode at each ζ so that area loss and spillover heating are recorded separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: For ζ ≤ 26.4°, A_e = η·π(150 m)² = 0.63 × 70 686 = 44 532 m², gain G = A_e/(2k) ≈ 16.1 K/Jy and SEFD = T_sys/G = 24/16.1 ≈ 1.49 Jy. A geometric estimate of the fraction of the 300 m aperture still on the dish is 0.97 at ζ = 30°, 0.90 at 35° and 0.80 at 40° for uniform illumination, or about 0.89 at 40° when weighted by a −10 dB edge taper.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「天頂角極限與有效接收面積」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Zenith-angle limit and effective collecting area", which statement holds?
options: 5 mm 的面形精度在 500 MHz 與 3 GHz 一樣好。
頻譜基線漣波只來自接收機電子，與望遠鏡幾何無關。
optionsEn: A 5 mm surface performs equally well at 500 MHz and 3 GHz.
Spectral baseline ripple comes only from receiver electronics, not telescope geometry.
quiz.explanationEn: For ζ ≤ 26.4°, A_e = η·π(150 m)² = 0.63 × 70 686 = 44 532 m², gain G = A_e/(2k) ≈ 16.1 K/Jy and SEFD = T_sys/G = 24/16.1 ≈ 1.49 Jy. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 天頂角極限與有效接收面積：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Zenith-angle limit and effective collecting area: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「天頂角與照明區位置」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Zenith angle and illuminated patch” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 建立增益曲線：在多個天頂角對 3C286 等流量已知的校準源做十字掃描，取峰值天線溫度除以目錄流量得到 K/Jy，畫出對 ζ 的曲線並確認轉折出現在 26.4° 附近；同一時間用雜訊二極體量各 ζ 的 T_sys，把面積下降與溢出升溫兩個效應分開記錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build the gain curve: cross-scan a calibrator of known flux such as 3C286 at several zenith angles, divide peak antenna temperature by catalogue flux to obtain K/Jy, plot against ζ and confirm the knee near 26.4°; at the same time measure T_sys with the noise diode at each ζ so that area loss and spillover heating are recorded separately. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：對 ζ = 35° 到 40° 的觀測仍套用天頂增益，流量密度與 HI 質量會被低估 10% 到 20%；長時間追蹤跨越 26.4° 時，源看起來在「變亮變暗」，其實只是幾何遮蔽造成的假變光。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Applying the zenith gain to observations at ζ = 35° to 40° underestimates flux densities and HI masses by 10% to 20%; long tracks crossing 26.4° show a source apparently brightening and fading when the variation is purely geometric vignetting.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 建立增益曲線：在多個天頂角對 3C286 等流量已知的校準源做十字掃描，取峰值天線溫度除以目錄流量得到 K/Jy，畫出對 ζ 的曲線並確認轉折出現在 26.4° 附近；同一時間用雜訊二極體量各 ζ 的 T_sys，把面積下降與溢出升溫兩個效應分開記錄。
knowledge.textEn: Build the gain curve: cross-scan a calibrator of known flux such as 3C286 at several zenith angles, divide peak antenna temperature by catalogue flux to obtain K/Jy, plot against ζ and confirm the knee near 26.4°; at the same time measure T_sys with the noise diode at each ζ so that area loss and spillover heating are recorded separately.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「天頂角極限與有效接收面積」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Zenith-angle limit and effective collecting area"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
建立增益曲線：在多個天頂角對 3C286 等流量已知的校準源做十字掃描，取峰值天線溫度除以目錄流量得到 K/Jy，畫出對 ζ 的曲線並確認轉折出現在 26.4° 附近。
電波寧靜區可以擋掉所有干擾，包括衛星訊號。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.

Build the gain curve: cross-scan a calibrator of known flux such as 3C286 at several zenith angles, divide peak antenna temperature by catalogue flux to obtain K/Jy, plot against ζ and confirm the knee near 26.4°.
A radio quiet zone blocks all interference, satellite signals included.
quiz.explanation: 建立增益曲線：在多個天頂角對 3C286 等流量已知的校準源做十字掃描，取峰值天線溫度除以目錄流量得到 K/Jy，畫出對 ζ 的曲線並確認轉折出現在 26.4° 附近；同一時間用雜訊二極體量各 ζ 的 T_sys，把面積下降與溢出升溫兩個效應分開記錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build the gain curve: cross-scan a calibrator of known flux such as 3C286 at several zenith angles, divide peak antenna temperature by catalogue flux to obtain K/Jy, plot against ζ and confirm the knee near 26.4°; at the same time measure T_sys with the noise diode at each ζ so that area loss and spillover heating are recorded separately. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.instruction: 對 ζ = 35° 到 40° 的觀測仍套用天頂增益，流量密度與 HI 質量會被低估 10% 到 20%；長時間追蹤跨越 26.4° 時，源看起來在「變亮變暗」，其實只是幾何遮蔽造成的假變光。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Applying the zenith gain to observations at ζ = 35° to 40° underestimates flux densities and HI masses by 10% to 20%; long tracks crossing 26.4° show a source apparently brightening and fading when the variation is purely geometric vignetting. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計上限 ζ = 40°，配合約 25.6°N 的緯度，可觀測赤緯約 −14° 到 +66°。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The design limit is ζ = 40°, which at about 25.6°N latitude gives declinations from about −14° to +66°.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「FAST 反射面固定不動，所以增益與天頂角無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Because FAST's dish never moves, its gain does not depend on zenith angle." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 對 ζ = 35° 到 40° 的觀測仍套用天頂增益，流量密度與 HI 質量會被低估 10% 到 20%；長時間追蹤跨越 26.4° 時，源看起來在「變亮變暗」，其實只是幾何遮蔽造成的假變光。
knowledge.textEn: Applying the zenith gain to observations at ζ = 35° to 40° underestimates flux densities and HI masses by 10% to 20%; long tracks crossing 26.4° show a source apparently brightening and fading when the variation is purely geometric vignetting.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「天頂角極限與有效接收面積」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Zenith-angle limit and effective collecting area" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
索網只承受靜態重量，不必考慮疲勞壽命。
對 ζ = 35° 到 40° 的觀測仍套用天頂增益，流量密度與 HI 質量會被低估 10% 到 20%。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
The cable net carries only static weight, so fatigue life can be ignored.
Applying the zenith gain to observations at ζ = 35° to 40° underestimates flux densities and HI masses by 10% to 20%.
quiz.explanation: 對 ζ = 35° 到 40° 的觀測仍套用天頂增益，流量密度與 HI 質量會被低估 10% 到 20%；長時間追蹤跨越 26.4° 時，源看起來在「變亮變暗」，其實只是幾何遮蔽造成的假變光。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Applying the zenith gain to observations at ζ = 35° to 40° underestimates flux densities and HI masses by 10% to 20%; long tracks crossing 26.4° show a source apparently brightening and fading when the variation is purely geometric vignetting. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
